reason: A DSH sidebar visualization plugin that presents per-session token usage, cache-hit metrics, Beijing-time pricing calculations, and synchronized cost estimates.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中按会话展示 Token 用量、缓存命中率、北京时间分时费用和价格同步结果。
summaries.en: A DSH sidebar plugin that displays per-session token usage, cache-hit rates, Beijing-time pricing calculations, and synchronized cost estimates.

capabilities: Reads and aggregates per-session token usage records
Displays token counts, cache-hit rates, timestamps, and calculated costs
Fetches pricing data from DeepSeek pricing pages
Exposes a local JSON usage route for the plugin client
